title: Pacman
source_topic: CodeChef / ACM-ICPC Asia-India Finals Mirror Contest 2016
statement: Pacman is a software package manager. It has a repository of **N** softwares numbered from **1** to **N**. A software may have a dependency on another software. Fortunately, each software has **at most 1 dependency**. In order to install a software, we must first install its dependency (if any).
